beijing.description: Historic palaces, hutong lanes and museums make Beijing a rewarding cultural city break.
attractions: Palace Museum: the Forbidden City palace complex; allow at least half a day
Temple of Heaven: ceremonial halls and parkland
Badaling or Mutianyu Great Wall: a day trip beyond the city
Jingshan Park: views over the historic central axis
beijing.food: Peking duck, zhajiang noodles and douzhi.
beijing.tip: PKX is Beijing Daxing Airport, south of the city. Allow additional ground-transfer time.

changzhou.description: Jiangnan heritage meets large theme parks, with options for families and temple visits.
attractions: Tianning Temple and Pagoda: a landmark temple complex
China Dinosaur Park: a major theme park
Yancheng Spring and Autumn Park: a historical theme attraction
changzhou.tip: Attractions are spread across the city. Allow a full day for a theme park.

hefei.description: Explore Anhui history, urban parks and nearby old towns at a relaxed pace.
attractions: Baogong Park: sites commemorating Bao Zheng
Anhui Museum: regional history and collections
Sanhe Ancient Town: a waterside town requiring a separate transfer
hefei.food: Luzhou roast duck and Anhui-style fermented mandarin fish.
hefei.tip: Sanhe is outside central Hefei; plan a separate half-day or full-day visit.

ningbo.description: A historic port with old libraries, waterfront streets, lakes and seafood.
attractions: Tianyi Pavilion Museum: a historic private library
Ningbo Old Bund: a historic port district
Dongqian Lake: lakeside cycling and leisure
Tianyi Square: central shopping and evening walks
ningbo.food: Ningbo rice balls, seafood and marinated crab.
ningbo.tip: Dongqian Lake is outside the centre and suits a half-day excursion.

sanya.description: A tropical Hainan escape for beaches, bays and island scenery.
attractions: Yalong Bay: beaches and resort hotels
Wuzhizhou Island: island views and water activities
Tianya Haijiao: coastal rock formations
Nanshan Cultural Tourism Zone: coastal religious landmarks
sanya.food: Hainanese chicken rice, coconut chicken and seafood.
sanya.tip: Sea conditions affect beaches and boat trips. Check same-day activity and safety notices.

wuxi.description: Discover Taihu Lake, Jiangnan gardens, temples and canal-side streets.
attractions: Yuantouzhu: Taihu scenery and seasonal cherry blossom
Lingshan Grand Buddha: a large Buddhist cultural site
Nanchang Street and Qingming Bridge: a canal heritage district
Li Garden: traditional Jiangnan landscaping
wuxi.food: Wuxi soup dumplings and braised pork ribs.
wuxi.tip: Yuantouzhu and Lingshan are far apart; do not plan to walk between them.

yiwu.description: Known for international trade, Yiwu also offers old streets and local food.
attractions: Yiwu International Trade City: a large wholesale market
Fotang Ancient Town: traditional lanes and architecture
Jiming Pavilion and Jiming Mountain Park: city views and walking routes
yiwu.food: Brown-sugar twists and Donghe meat pancakes.
yiwu.tip: Trade City is primarily a working wholesale market. Check the halls and opening arrangements before visiting.

taipei.description: Combine landmark views, cultural collections, temples and lively night markets.
attractions: Taipei 101: landmark tower and observation decks
National Palace Museum: major Chinese art collections
Longshan Temple: traditional temple and neighbourhood
Shilin Night Market: a well-known food market
taipei.food: Beef noodles, braised pork rice and bubble tea.
taipei.tip: TPE is Taoyuan International Airport; allow time for the journey to central Taipei.

taichung.description: Modern architecture, creative neighbourhoods, night markets and central Taiwan excursions.
attractions: National Taichung Theater: sculptural architecture and performances
Gaomei Wetlands: coastal sunsets and birdwatching
Fengjia Night Market: food stalls and shopping
Sun Moon Lake: in Nantou County; plan a separate day trip
taichung.food: Sun cakes, sausage in sticky rice and bubble tea.
taichung.tip: Gaomei and Sun Moon Lake require transfers. Wetland boardwalk access depends on tides and opening arrangements.

kaohsiung.description: A harbour city of art warehouses, waterfront spaces, temples and cycling routes.
attractions: Dragon and Tiger Pagodas at Lotus Pond: landmark temple scenery
Pier-2 Art Center: converted harbour warehouses
Cijin: a seaside peninsula reached by ferry
Dome of Light at Formosa Boulevard Station: public art
kaohsiung.food: Duck rice, seafood and papaya milk.
kaohsiung.tip: Allow ferry time for Cijin and check the weather before seaside activities.

tokyo.description: A first-time Japan favourite, combining modern districts, temples, museums and food.
attractions: Senso-ji and Kaminarimon: historic Asakusa
Shibuya Crossing: a city landmark
Meiji Jingu: a shrine set within central woodland
Tokyo Skytree: tower and observation decks
tokyo.tip: HND Haneda and NRT Narita are separate airports with different city-transfer times and options.

osaka.description: A Kansai food capital with neon canal-side streets and major entertainment attractions.
attractions: Dotonbori: food, shopping and canal-side nightlife
Osaka Castle Park: historic architecture and seasonal scenery
Universal Studios Japan: a major theme park
Kuromon Market: food stalls and snacks
osaka.tip: KIX is Kansai International Airport, serving Osaka and the wider Kansai region.

nagoya.description: A central Japan transport hub for castles, shopping streets and distinctive local dishes.
attractions: Nagoya Castle: check official notices for keep access
Atsuta Jingu: a historic shrine
Osu Shopping District: shops, food and pop culture
Ghibli Park: outside the city in Nagakute; reservations are usually needed
nagoya.food: Hitsumabushi eel rice, miso pork cutlet and miso udon.
nagoya.tip: NGO Chubu Centrair Airport is in Tokoname, outside central Nagoya.

fukuoka.description: An accessible Kyushu gateway for food, parks and a relaxed city stay.
attractions: Ohori Park: lakeside walks and gardens
Dazaifu Tenmangu: a shrine outside central Fukuoka
Fukuoka Tower: coastal city views
Canal City Hakata: shopping and entertainment
fukuoka.food: Hakata tonkotsu ramen, motsunabe and mentaiko.
fukuoka.tip: Dazaifu is an excursion beyond the centre. Combine walking and public transport for city visits.

hiroshima.description: Explore peace memorials and cultural heritage alongside Seto Inland Sea island scenery.
attractions: Hiroshima Peace Memorial Park: a place of remembrance
Atomic Bomb Dome: a World Heritage landmark
Itsukushima Shrine on Miyajima: a coastal shrine and torii
Mount Misen: hiking and island views
hiroshima.tip: HIJ is some distance from central Hiroshima; Miyajima requires further rail and ferry travel.

okinawa.description: Ryukyuan culture, subtropical coasts, market streets and island leisure.
attractions: Kokusai-dori: shopping and Okinawan food in Naha
Shuri Castle Park: check official restoration and access notices
Okinawa Churaumi Aquarium: in the north of the main island
Cape Manzamo: coastal cliffs
okinawa.food: Okinawa soba, goya champuru and sea grapes.
okinawa.tip: OKA serves Naha. Allow a longer road journey to the aquarium in northern Okinawa.

sendai.description: A Tohoku gateway for Date Masamune history and Matsushima Bay excursions.
attractions: Zuihoden: a historic mausoleum complex
Sendai Castle ruins: Aobayama views and history
Jozenji-dori: a tree-lined avenue
Matsushima Bay: a popular day trip beyond the city
sendai.food: Grilled beef tongue and zunda sweets.
sendai.tip: SDJ is Sendai Airport. Allow rail travel between central Sendai and Matsushima.

takamatsu.description: A Seto Inland Sea gateway for Japanese gardens, udon and art-island trips.
attractions: Ritsurin Garden: a traditional landscape garden
Takamatsu Castle ruins / Tamamo Park: a coastal castle site
Yashima: hilltop scenery and historic sites
Naoshima: an art island reached by boat; check connections
takamatsu.tip: Naoshima is not in central Takamatsu; allow waiting and sailing time.

komatsu.description: An airport gateway to Komatsu, Kaga hot springs and the traditional districts of Kanazawa.
attractions: Natadera: a wooded temple and rock scenery in Komatsu
Awazu Onsen: one of the Kaga hot-spring areas
Kenrokuen: a garden requiring a transfer to Kanazawa
Higashi Chaya District: historic tea-house streets in Kanazawa
komatsu.food: Kaga cuisine, Kanazawa seafood and gold-leaf sweets.
komatsu.tip: KMQ is Komatsu Airport, not a central Kanazawa airport. Plan onward ground transport.

ishigaki.description: A Yaeyama island getaway with coral seas, coastal viewpoints and nearby island villages.
attractions: Kabira Bay: scenery and glass-bottom boats; some areas are unsuitable for swimming
Tamatorizaki Observatory: coast and mountain views
Taketomi Island: traditional red-tile villages reached by boat
Yonehara Beach: check sea conditions before entering the water
ishigaki.tip: Seasonal destination: the cited HK Express notice lists summer service for 28 March–30 October 2027. Check current official schedules before booking.

seoul.description: Discover palace heritage, shopping districts, cafes and Korean food.
attractions: Gyeongbokgung: a major Joseon palace
Bukchon Hanok Village: respect residents and visitor restrictions
N Seoul Tower: city views from Namsan
Myeongdong: shopping and food streets
seoul.tip: ICN is Incheon International Airport. Allow an onward transfer to central Seoul.

busan.description: A port city combining urban beaches, colourful hillside districts and seafood markets.
attractions: Haeundae Beach: beach and skyline
Gamcheon Culture Village: a colourful hillside neighbourhood
Gwangalli Beach: views of the illuminated bridge
Jagalchi Market: seafood and harbour life
busan.food: Pork soup with rice, fish cakes and seafood.
busan.tip: Haeundae and Gamcheon are far apart; organise visits by area.

daegu.description: A city break for hilltop views, traditional markets and local food.
attractions: Apsan Park and Observatory: city views
Seomun Market: traditional market and evening food
Donghwasa: a temple near Palgongsan
Kim Gwangseok Street: a music-themed neighbourhood
daegu.tip: Mountain paths and cable-car services may be affected by weather; check access before travelling.

jeju.description: A volcanic island of coastal drives, hiking routes and distinctive local dishes.
attractions: Seongsan Ilchulbong: a volcanic tuff cone
Hallasan National Park: check trail and reservation arrangements
Jusangjeolli cliffs: coastal volcanic formations
Udo: a nearby island reached by boat
jeju.food: Black pork, abalone porridge and citrus products.
jeju.tip: Jeju is a large island. Travel times differ considerably by bus and car.

bangkok.description: A tropical metropolis of riverside temples, markets and modern shopping.
attractions: Wat Arun: a landmark beside the Chao Phraya River
Grand Palace and Wat Phra Kaew: historic landmarks
Wat Pho: temple complex and reclining Buddha
Chatuchak Weekend Market: best planned around its weekend operation
bangkok.food: Tom yum, pad thai and mango sticky rice.
bangkok.tip: BKK is Suvarnabhumi Airport, not DMK Don Mueang. Observe temple dress requirements.

chiang-mai.description: Northern Thailand temples, mountain trips, night markets and relaxed cafe culture.
attractions: Wat Phra That Doi Suthep: a hillside temple
Wat Chedi Luang: a major old-city temple
Sunday Walking Street: an evening market
Doi Inthanon National Park: a separate mountain day trip
chiang-mai.food: Khao soi and northern Thai sausage.
chiang-mai.tip: Doi Inthanon is far from the city. Rain and mountain-road conditions can affect plans.

phuket.description: An Andaman island escape for beaches, old-town streets and boat excursions.
attractions: Promthep Cape: a sunset viewpoint
Phuket Old Town: colourful Sino-Portuguese streets
Patong Beach: beach and nightlife
Phi Phi Islands: a boat excursion subject to sea conditions
phuket.food: Southern Thai curry, seafood and fried noodles.
phuket.tip: Boat trips, snorkelling and island crossings depend strongly on wind, sea conditions and the season.

hanoi.description: Discover old streets, lakeside life, historic architecture and Vietnamese food.
attractions: Hoan Kiem Lake: lakeside walks near the old quarter
Hanoi Old Quarter: narrow streets and traditional shops
Temple of Literature: historic education and Confucian heritage
Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum: check official access arrangements
hanoi.food: Pho, bun cha and egg coffee.
hanoi.tip: HAN Noi Bai Airport is outside the city. The old quarter is well suited to walking.

da-nang.description: A gateway to central Vietnam beaches, mountain attractions and nearby heritage towns.
attractions: Golden Bridge at Ba Na Hills: a mountaintop landmark
My Khe Beach: the city coast
Marble Mountains: caves, temples and views
Hoi An Ancient Town: outside Da Nang; allow a separate half-day or full day
da-nang.food: Mi Quang noodles and Vietnamese pancakes.
da-nang.tip: Golden Bridge is inside the Ba Na Hills attraction; plan transfers, admission and cable-car access.

phu-quoc.description: A southern Vietnam island for sunsets, beaches and boat trips.
attractions: Sao Beach: a well-known island beach
Hon Thom cable car: sea views
Dinh Cau: a coastal landmark
Phu Quoc National Park: forest and nature
phu-quoc.food: Seafood, fish-sauce dishes and local pepper dishes.
phu-quoc.tip: Monsoons and sea conditions affect boat trips and island access. Check same-day information.

kuala-lumpur.description: A multicultural city of skyscrapers, limestone temples and food districts.
attractions: Petronas Twin Towers: a city landmark
Batu Caves: Hindu temples and limestone caves
Merdeka Square: historic architecture
KL Tower: city views
kuala-lumpur.food: Nasi lemak, satay and char kway teow.
kuala-lumpur.tip: The airport in this guide is SZB Subang, not KUL Kuala Lumpur International. Check the airport code.

penang.description: A food and heritage destination centred on George Town and island scenery.
attractions: George Town heritage area: historic streets and murals
Kek Lok Si: a large temple complex
Penang Hill: city and strait views
Batu Ferringhi: coastal leisure
penang.food: Char kway teow, assam laksa and Hokkien mee.
penang.tip: George Town, Penang Hill and Batu Ferringhi are in different parts of the island.

kota-kinabalu.description: A Sabah gateway for nearby islands, coastal sunsets and rainforest excursions.
attractions: Kota Kinabalu City Mosque: waterfront reflections
Tunku Abdul Rahman Marine Park: islands and snorkelling
Tanjung Aru Beach: sunset views
Kinabalu Park: a mountain excursion far from the city
kota-kinabalu.food: Sabah seafood, Tuaran noodles and coconut pudding.
kota-kinabalu.tip: Respect mosque dress and visiting arrangements. Kinabalu Park needs a longer road journey.

manila.description: Explore colonial-era streets, national collections and a busy metropolitan capital.
attractions: Intramuros: the historic walled city
Fort Santiago: a historic landmark
Rizal Park: a major city park
National Museum of Fine Arts: public art collections
manila.tip: MNL serves metropolitan Manila. Congestion can greatly increase transfers between attractions.

clark.description: A Pampanga gateway for Clark Freeport and guided volcanic-landscape excursions.
attractions: Mount Pinatubo crater lake: guides and transfers are needed; access depends on weather and management
Clark Museum: local history
Clark Freeport: parks, dining and leisure
Aqua Planet: check current opening arrangements
clark.tip: CRK Clark International is not MNL Manila. Pinatubo trips may need permits, specialist vehicles and guides.
